title: Silver prices are tarnished but not forgotten. Why HSBC thinks gains in white metal may be limited?
description: Silver prices have plunged nearly 60% from their January record high, but HSBC expects limited gains ahead. The bank sees prices consolidating and edging higher in 2027, supported by gold, while rising mine output, recycling supply, weaker industrial demand, a firm US dollar and elevated yields could cap rallies.

title: Sumitomo Life to remain cautious on JGB yields, keep investment pace unchanged from H1
description: Sumitomo Life Insurance will maintain its investment pace for Japanese government bonds in the upcoming months. It intends to carefully monitor yields on super-long Japanese government bonds, assessing any market volatility. The firm expects its JGB holdings to decrease in the Asset Liability Management portfolio by the end of the fiscal year. Predictions suggest that the Bank of Japan will raise its policy rate by December.

title: French bond selloff eases as country spared ratings downgrade
description: On Monday, the selloff in French government bonds paused after Moody's maintained its rating of Aa3. Weekend protests were mostly peaceful, reducing tensions in the country. France's 10-year OAT yield fell following a rise to its highest level since June 2002. The focus now turns to the European Central Bank's upcoming policy decision on Thursday. Analysts expect the ECB to monitor the rising yields closely and evaluate their impact.

title: Global Market: BOJ nears historic inflation milestone, shifts focus to rate hikes
description: The Bank of Japan is expected to declare its nearly 14-year battle to achieve 2% inflation successful while keeping interest rates unchanged at 1.25%. With wage growth and inflation expectations strengthening, policymakers may signal further tightening, potentially in December, as they balance persistent price pressures against economic growth and financial stability.

title: ECB Meeting: Five key questions on rates, inflation and Lagarde's exit
